title: How far a class has travelled

handbook.what: A bar showing where a class has got to in its course, measured in LEGOs — the individual pieces of language the course teaches. The class's own shared position leads, and the average its students have reached on their own sits alongside it.
handbook.where: The **Course journey** card on a class page.
how: Read the bar for how much of the course the class has covered together.
The line underneath gives both figures: the class's shared position, and the average students have reached learning alone.
It also names the next belt and how many LEGOs are left to reach it.
handbook.note: A class that has never played together has no shared position, so the bar falls back to the students' own average and says so.
